mot.plan.altezza_minima: output height {altezza}: ask for at least 64. Anything lower isn't a target, it's a typo.
mot.plan.interlacciato: Interlaced or telecined source: it is NOT handled here. The upscale would amplify the combing lines. Prepare it first with a dedicated tool, then put it back in INPUT.
mot.plan.dedup_campione: {quota} measured on a sample of this file
mot.plan.dedup_nessun_esatto: no exact duplicates; the perceptual comparison runs at start, where animation "on twos" usually shows up
mot.plan.crf_fuori_scala: CRF {crf} out of range: x265 accepts 0 to 51.
mot.plan.gia_uguale: the file is {larghezza}x{altezza}, already exactly the requested size ({bersaglio})
mot.plan.gia_piu_grande: the file is {larghezza}x{altezza}, already larger than the target ({bersaglio})
mot.plan.guadagno_piccolo: {da} to {a} is only {guadagno}x, below the {soglia}x threshold
mot.plan.niente_da_fare: {motivo}: there's nothing to do. This tool upscales, and only when the gain is worth the hours it costs. Raise the output height for a real upscale.
mot.plan.bersaglio_abbassato: Target lowered from {chiesto}p to {ottenuto}p: from {sorgente}, 4x is the most you can ask of a model without it inventing everything.
mot.plan.rimedio_scala_forzata: The scale is forced to {scala}: drop --scale and let it choose, or lower the target to {altezza}p
mot.plan.rimedio_nessuno: No model in the catalogue goes higher: from {sorgente} the honest maximum is {altezza}p. Lower the target
mot.plan.non_arriva: {modello} reaches at most {massimo}, below the {bersaglio} target: lanczos would cover the last stretch, i.e. enlargement with no added detail. {rimedio}.
mot.plan.forzato_guadagno: Forced: the upscale is only {guadagno}x, below the {soglia}x threshold. It costs the hours of a full upscale for a few extra pixels.
mot.plan.vfr: VFR source: frames will be extracted on a constant grid at {fps} fps. The source isn't re-encoded.
mot.plan.mov_text: mov_text subtitles converted to SRT (MKV can't copy them).
mot.plan.spazio_insufficiente: At least {servono} GB is needed just for the extracted frames and the video, more than the {dedicati} GB set aside: the peak will be ~{picco} GB.
mot.plan.spazio_stretto: Tight on space: {restano} GB is left for chunks after the frames, so {blocchi} chunks instead of fewer. Setting aside more space saves a few minutes.
mot.modello.animevideov3.label: Real-ESRGAN animevideov3
mot.modello.animevideov3.descrizione: the fastest. Very crisp lines, but it flattens background texture: less detail and far fewer artefacts
mot.modello.cugan-denoise.label: Real-CUGAN light denoise
mot.modello.cugan-denoise.descrizione: the middle ground. Keeps texture and gradients while cleaning up the most visible noise: for sources that aren't clean
mot.modello.cugan.label: Real-CUGAN no-denoise
mot.modello.cugan.descrizione: keeps everything: texture, gradients and, unfortunately, the noise too. For sources that are already clean
mot.modello.consiglio_alta: {altezza}p source: a modest upscale, so it pays to keep texture and gradients
mot.modello.consiglio_media: {altezza}p source: middle band. animevideov3 is the recommended baseline (fewer artefacts). If the file deserves more detail, check CUGAN light denoise in Compare; no-denoise would amplify the noise
mot.modello.consiglio_bassa: {altezza}p source: at this resolution there's no real detail to keep, and CUGAN would enlarge the compression artefacts. Less detailed, far fewer artefacts
mot.pipe.non_scrivibile: can't write to {cartella}: {errore}. Check the permissions of the output folder.
mot.pipe.spazio: not enough space: about {servono} GB needed, {liberi} GB free. Free up space, lower the output height, or reduce the space per chunk.
mot.pipe.spazio_altrui: not enough space: about {servono} GB needed, {liberi} GB free, of which {altrui} already reserved by another job in progress. Free up space, lower the output height, or reduce the space per chunk.
mot.pipe.gia_in_corso: another job on this file is already running (folder {cartella}). Wait for it to finish, or delete {lucchetto} if you're sure it's dead.
mot.pipe.cartella_abbandonata: there's another one for this file ({cartella}): ignored, resuming from the most recent. If you don't need it, delete it by hand.
mot.pipe.estrazione_vuota: extraction produced no frames: the source is unreadable or the restoration chain discards everything.
mot.pipe.estratti_diversi: extracted {estratti} frames against the {stimati} estimated from the source: the audio may be out of sync
mot.pipe.segmenti_non_validi: the extracted frame count is missing or has changed: the previous segments are no longer valid and will be redone
mot.pipe.assemblaggio: joining the segments and remuxing the tracks
mot.pipe.non_verificabile: couldn't verify the final file: check it by hand
mot.pipe.fotogrammi_diversi: the final file has {scritti} frames instead of {attesi}
mot.pipe.geometria_diversa: the final file is {geometria} instead of {attesa}
mot.pipe.audio_seek: the audio doesn't respond to a seek to mid-file: the tracks are badly written in the container (the video is fine, but the file needs redoing with a remux only)
mot.pipe.misura_fallita: measuring frame differences failed: deduplication skipped
mot.pipe.misura_sfasata: measured {misurati} frames instead of {attesi}: deduplication skipped to be safe
mot.pipe.dedup_disattivata: Deduplication was turned off for this file: the map of repeated frames wasn't consistent. All frames will be processed (slower, same result)
mot.pipe.falsi_duplicati: {n} frames had been wrongly treated as repeats: they're being processed anyway, one by one
mot.pipe.disco_pieno: — but the disk has only {liberi} GB free: that's almost certainly the cause, not the frames.
mot.dedup.riepilogo: {unici}/{totale} frames to process ({risparmio} saved) - longest run {massima}, average {media}
mot.backend.stallo: no new frame for {minuti} minutes (stuck at {fatti} of {attesi})
mot.backend.piantato: the model hung: {motivo}. It was stopped. Run it again: the job resumes where it left off.
mot.backend.codice_uscita: the model exited with code {codice} ({prodotti}/{attesi} frames).
mot.encode.timeout: ffmpeg hasn't responded for {ore} hours: stopped. Check that the disk is still connected, then run it again.
mot.paths.binario_mancante:
Binary '{nome}' not found in {cartella} or on the PATH.
To make the folder truly portable, run:  ./animeup setup
mot.preview.niente_salto: This file doesn't allow seeking: decoding from the start, usually a few minutes for an episode (only once, then it's kept in memory)
mot.preview.prova_scuro: banding in dark gradients, amplified noise
mot.preview.prova_luminoso: crisp lines, halos on high-contrast edges
mot.preview.motivo_movimento: motion {movimento} against an episode average of {media}
mot.preview.motivo_statico: almost still (motion {movimento}): this is where texture and banding show
mot.preview.motivo_scuro: dark scene (brightness {luminosita}) with motion: gradients at risk of banding
mot.preview.aperto_iina: video-compare isn't installed: opened in IINA
mot.preview.nessuno_strumento:
no comparison tool found. Install video-compare with:
    brew install video-compare
mot.taratura.salvataggio_senza_base: {testa} — the test of the default value failed, so nothing was changed.
mot.taratura.salvataggio_poco: {testa} — tried {provati}: the best gained only {guadagno}, below the threshold that makes a change worthwhile.
mot.taratura.salvataggio_cambiato: {testa} instead of {predefinito}: {guadagno} on upscaling at the high scales, with identical output.
mot.taratura.clip_mancante: sample clip missing: {percorso}. samples/{clip} is required (see samples/README.md).
mot.taratura.gia_in_corso: a calibration is already running on this machine: wait for it to finish (it carries on even with the window closed).
mot.taratura.upscale_incompleto: {modello} x{scala}: produced {fatti} of {attesi} frames — measurement unreliable, calibration stopped
